description: NimbleBrain's Renovate policy: when Renovate runs, how long a release waits, and how majors and security fixes are handled. Which managers run and which packages group together belong to each repo's own renovate.json.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Off by default: a refresh has no single release date, so Renovate cannot hold it to the 14-day wait, and the refresh would bring in versions published that day. A repo whose package manager enforces the wait itself (bunfig.toml's minimumReleaseAge, uv's exclude-newer) turns it on with "lockFileMaintenance": {"enabled": true}.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security fix skips the schedule, the release wait, and dashboard approval.
